Our school

How the CBC Curriculum Prepares Learners for Real-World Problem Solving

How the CBC Curriculum Prepares Learners for Real-World Problem Solving
Learning
How the CBC Curriculum Prepares Learners for Real-World Problem Solving
Discover how Kenya’s Competency-Based Curriculum shifts the educational focus from rote memorization to skill mastery and creative solutions.
By Enock Maina · CASA Team10 May 20255 min read
The transition from the traditional 8-4-4 education system to the Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC) marks one of the most progressive educational shifts in Kenyan history. For parents and teachers at Creative All Stars Academy, located in the heart of Nakuru, this shift is more than just a structural change—it is a cultural revolution in how children learn, think, and interact with the world.
The Heart of CBC: Skill Over Memorization
Under the old curriculum, students were largely assessed based on their ability to memorize formulas, dates, and spelling lists. CBC flips this script. It focuses on seven core competencies:
Communication and Collaboration
Critical Thinking and Problem Solving
Imagination and Creativity
Citizenship and Patriotism
Learning to Learn
Self-efficacy
Digital Literacy
Practical Application in Action
Take, for instance, a recent Grade 4 Agriculture project at our campus. Instead of reading about plant lifecycle solely from textbooks, students planted seedlings in recycled plastic containers, monitored daily growth, calculated water metrics, and discussed ecological impact. They applied mathematics, environmental conservation, and manual craftsmanship in a single project. This hands-on, multi-disciplinary approach ensures that knowledge is not merely stored, but lived.
Preparing for the Future
The modern global economy values adaptable individuals who can think on their feet, code, collaborate, and design. At Creative All Stars Academy, we embrace the CBC with open arms, integrating high-tech tools like computer labs and creative activities like dramatic elocution. We are not just training children to pass exams; we are nurturing the future leaders, innovators, and thinkers of Nakuru and the world.

A little guidance
Common questions.
Where is Creative All Stars Academy located?+
The school is located in Ngata, Nakuru. Visit the Contact page for the current Google Maps location, telephone number and office hours.
Which education approach does the school follow?+
Creative All Stars Academy follows Kenya’s competency-based education approach. Learning is learner-centred and supports the development of knowledge, skills, values and attitudes. The exact curriculum designs and learning areas depend on the learner’s level.
How can I get the current school fees?+
Fee information is shared directly with families. Please call +254 114 813 030 or send a message through our Contact page to request the current fee structure and payment instructions.
How do I apply for admission?+
Complete the enquiry form on the Admissions page or contact the school. The admissions team will guide you through the required documents, learner interaction and class placement.
Where can I buy the school uniform?+
All Creative All Stars Academy uniforms are available at Woolshop. The complete uniform requirements for ECDE, Primary and Junior School are listed in the Parents Corner.
Which co-curricular activities are offered?+
Activities include guidance and counselling, journalism, games and sports, drama and music, debate, scouting and Health Club. Contact the school for the current activity schedule.
Need a little more information?
For current fees, transport, meals, collection arrangements or learning support, our team can explain the details directly.

sources.title: Website privacy notice | Creative All Stars Academy
sources.text:
How information submitted through the Creative All Stars Academy website is used.

Website privacy notice | Creative All Stars Academy
Skip to contentCreative All Stars AcademyEndeavour to SucceedOur schoolLearningAdmissionsFor parentsContactEnquire nowMenu+
Home
Privacy notice
Your information
Website privacy notice.
This notice explains the information collected through this website. It covers website enquiries, job applications and the school assistant.
Enquiries and applications
When you send an admission enquiry, we collect the child’s name, the class you are considering and the parent or guardian’s contact details. General contact messages include the information you enter in the contact form. We use these details to review and respond to your request.
If you apply for a vacancy, we collect your contact details, the selected vacancy and the PDF you choose to upload. Candidate documents are available through the protected staff workspace.
Please avoid including medical details, identity documents, payment information or other sensitive information in general messages or chat. The admissions team will explain how to provide any documents needed later.
Public comments
If you post a comment on a school story, your name, comment and the date are shown publicly. Do not include contact details or sensitive information in a comment.
The school assistant
The assistant sends your question and relevant school information to OpenAI to prepare an answer. The website does not save chat transcripts in the school’s enquiry inbox. If you choose to submit the separate admission form offered in chat, those details are saved as an admission enquiry.
AI answers can contain mistakes. Confirm class availability, fees and admission decisions directly with the school.
Website services
The website uses Cloudflare for hosting, storage and abuse prevention, including the security check on public forms. These services process requests to operate and protect the website. The Contact page embeds Google Maps; opening or loading the map connects to Google.
Submitted enquiries and applications are stored for the school team in a protected administrator workspace. Links to other services are governed by those services’ own privacy notices.
Questions about your information
For questions about information you have submitted, how long it is kept, or a request to access, correct or remove it, contact the school at info@creativeallstarsacademy.sc.ke or +254 114 813 030. Please identify the enquiry or application so the school can locate it.
